```{python}
import htmltools
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np
import sys
import os
import datetime


project_root = os.path.abspath(os.path.join(os.getcwd(), '..'))

if project_root not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, project_root)

from src.metrics_calculator import MetricsCalculator
from src.database import DatabaseManager


calculator_30d = MetricsCalculator(db_path="../data/analytics.db", days=30)
calculator_60d = MetricsCalculator(db_path="../data/analytics.db", days=60)
calculator_90d = MetricsCalculator(db_path="../data/analytics.db", days=90)
calculator_all = MetricsCalculator(db_path="../data/analytics.db", days=None)

db = DatabaseManager("../data/analytics.db")

```

```{python}
def visualise_responder_diversity(calculator: MetricsCalculator) -> None:
    sns.set_theme(style="whitegrid", palette="Set2")
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(12, 8))
    df = calculator.get_responder_diversity(freq='QE')
    if df.empty:
        ax.text(0.5, 0.5, 'No data available for this period',
                horizontalalignment='center', verticalalignment='center',
                transform=ax.transAxes, fontsize=12, color='red')
        ax.set_title('Unique Discussion Responders per Quarter')
        plt.tight_layout()
        plt.show()
        return

    df = df.copy()
    df['period_label'] = pd.to_datetime(df['period']).dt.to_period('Q').astype(str)
    x = np.arange(len(df))
    width = 0.6
    ax.bar(x, df['core_team_responders'], width, label='Core Team',
           color=sns.color_palette('Set2')[0])
    ax.bar(x, df['community_responders'], width, bottom=df['core_team_responders'],
           label='Community', color=sns.color_palette('Set2')[1])
    ax.set_xticks(x)
    ax.set_xticklabels(df['period_label'], rotation=45, ha='right')
    ax.set_xlabel('Quarter')
    ax.set_ylabel('Unique Responders')
    ax.set_title('Unique Discussion Responders per Quarter')
    ax.legend()
    ax.grid(True, which='both', linestyle='--', linewidth=0.5, axis='y')
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.show()
```

```{python}
def visualise_discussions_by_category(calculator: MetricsCalculator) -> None:
    sns.set_theme(style="whitegrid", palette="Set2")
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(12, 8))
    df = calculator.get_discussions_opened_by_category(freq='QE')
    if df.empty:
        ax.text(0.5, 0.5, 'No data available for this period',
                horizontalalignment='center', verticalalignment='center',
                transform=ax.transAxes, fontsize=12, color='red')
        ax.set_title('Discussions Opened per Quarter by Category')
        plt.tight_layout()
        plt.show()
        return

    df = df.copy()
    df['period_label'] = pd.to_datetime(df['period']).dt.to_period('Q').astype(str)
    pivot = df.pivot_table(index='period_label', columns='category', values='count',
                            fill_value=0, sort=False)
    pivot = pivot.loc[sorted(pivot.index, key=lambda p: pd.Period(p))]
    palette = sns.color_palette('Set2', n_colors=max(len(pivot.columns), 3))
    pivot.plot(kind='bar', stacked=True, ax=ax, color=palette, width=0.7)
    ax.set_xlabel('Quarter')
    ax.set_ylabel('Discussions Opened')
    ax.set_title('Discussions Opened per Quarter by Category')
    ax.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
    ax.legend(title='Category')
    ax.grid(True, which='both', linestyle='--', linewidth=0.5, axis='y')
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.show()
```
